text: This report recommends that the name "Brixton Way" be approved to identify a proposed private street located at 400-440 Dufferin Street. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Brixton Way" to identify a proposed private street located at 400-440 Dufferin Street. 2. Requested the applicant to pay the costs, estimated to be $250.00, for the fabrication and installation of the street name signage; and 3. Requested the owner and successors of the subject lands to maintain, at their own risk, the street name signage installed under Recommendations 1 of the report.
